product.name: The Vector Computer
product.description: A Python framework and cloud infrastructure for building search and recommendation applications that combine structured and unstructured data using vector embeddings.

product.name: Multi-modal Vectors
product.description: Technology to combine text, images, and structured metadata into unified vector embeddings representing complex entities.

product.name: Multi-objective Queries
product.description: A querying capability that balances multiple factors like relevance, freshness, and popularity in vector search results.

product.name: Infrastructure as Code Python SDK
product.description: A Python SDK to manage the compute layer between data infrastructure and vector databases for vector embedding operations.

product.name: Auto-generated Ingestion and Query APIs
product.description: APIs that automatically handle entity ingestion and query execution with parameters for text and weighting in vector search systems.
